transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Greetings, mighty Thor! What brings you to our humble forge today? The master smiths are deep in the mines and won't be returning for several weeks. How can I be of service to you in their absence?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Ho there, my fellow dwarves! I have a matter of utmost importance that requires immediate attention. As you know, Mjölnir, my beloved hammer, was damaged in a recent battle. I have entrusted it to you, the skilled craftsmen of Nidavellir, to be reforged. Now, I find that the balance of the weapon is incorrect, causing it to pull to the left. Furthermore, the runes of binding are misspelled, weakening its enchantment. I demand that you rectify this at once! The fate of Asgard hangs in the balance!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Ah, I see! The balance and runes of mighty Mjölnir are no small matters indeed. However, as per the conditions set by the Sons of Ivaldi and Brokkr’s workshop, all commissions are considered fulfilled upon delivery to Asgard. Even with the greatest respect, I must inform you that even the gods must wait until the next forging-season and must pay anew for any adjustments. I assure you that I’d rectify it if I could, but the master smiths are the ones with the skills to do so. Would you like me to pass along a message to them for when they return?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Well, it seems I have little choice but to endure this inconvenience. Very well, I shall trust in the wisdom and skill of your master smiths. But mark my words, my hammer's future shall rest on your shoulders, Nidavellir. If you fail to restore its true balance and power, I shall not hesitate to bring forth the wrath of the gods upon you all!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I understand your frustration, Thor, and rest assured, your words will reach the ears of our master smiths as soon as they emerge from the mines. Trust in their craftsmanship and reputation—they will make Mjölnir as formidable as ever, once the season begins again. In the meantime, if there's any smaller task or repair I might assist with, I am at your service.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Thank you for your assurance, Nidavellir. I appreciate your willingness to help. For now, my only concern is ensuring the success of the reforging process. Once it is complete, we shall see if my hammer truly has been restored to its former glory. Until then, I shall keep watch over it and its progress. Thank you for your understanding.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: You're welcome, Thor. I’ll keep a close eye on Mjölnir until the masters return, and ensure your message is delivered with urgency. We hold deep respect for our craftsmanship and our connection to the gods. Do visit if you’ve any other concerns, or if perhaps you want to inspect how other works are coming along. I wish you strength and success in the battles ahead, until your mighty hammer is whole again.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Farewell, Nidavellir. I trust in your abilities and your unwavering commitment to Asgard. I shall await the return of the master smiths with anticipation, hoping that Mjölnir will once again be a symbol of my prowess and bravery. Until then, I shall continue my watch over the hammer, ready to unleash its power upon those who dare oppose us. May the gods smile upon us all. Farewell.
